name: Docmost
description: Open source collaborative wiki and documentation

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (all spaces and pages), uploaded files in storage/, Redis data, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Docmost web app, API and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6147

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Docmost at, like http://192.168.1.20:6147. Change localhost to your server IP so links in emails and shared pages work from other devices. Use your own domain if you put Docmost behind HTTPS.
